4.5. Programmatic Dependent Launch¶

The Programmatic Dependent Launch mechanism allows a dependent secondary kernel to launch before the primary kernel it depends on has finished.

4.5.2. API Description¶

The secondary kernel waits with cudaGridDependencySynchronize():

__global__ void secondary_kernel() {
    cudaGridDependencySynchronize();
    // dependent work
}

  • Set cudaLaunchAttributeProgrammaticStreamSerialization on the launch.

  • Use cudaLaunchKernelEx.

attributevalue
programmaticStreamSerializationAllowed1
